rightsDecision: Public historical facts from cited secondary sources only. No FidoNet nodelist or USBBS bulk data is bundled: per the round 17/18 rights decisions, checked nodelist prologues grant intra-FidoNet use/distribution and reserve other uses absent express written consent, so nodelists remain local-import-only (captureReady=false) until a lawfully redistributable snapshot exists. Coordinates are published/institutional approximations, not surveyed points, and no GNIS feature is claimed.
